name: Post Office Savings Account(SB)
benefit:
1. Safe place to keep money with 4% interest.
1. Easy to open with just ₹500 minimum balance.

**Interest on deposits**

1. Interest will be calculated based on minimum balance between 10th of the month and end of the month and allowed in whole rupees only.
1. No interest will be allowed in a month if balance at any time between 10th and last day of the month falls below ₹ 500/-.

_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a resident citizen of India. 1. The applicant can be a single adult opening an individual account. 1. The applicant can open a joint account with up to three adults. 1. The applicant can choose Joint ‘A’ type (operated jointly) or Joint ‘B’ type (operated by any holder). 1. The applicant can be a guardian opening an account on behalf of a minor. 1. The applicant can be a guardian opening an account for a person of unsound mind (Authorised Account). 1. The applicant can be a minor above 10 years who can open and operate the account. 1. The applicant can have only one single account in their name. 1. The applicant cannot convert a single account into a joint account or vice versa. 1. The applicant (in joint account) becomes the sole owner if other holders pass away, subject to rules. **Note:** Upon reaching the age of 18 years, account holders must submit a new Account Opening Form (AOF) and fresh KYC documents at their Post Office to convert their minor account into an adult account.
